```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)

```

# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

R2_A0 <- haven::read_sas("data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_sc_02_rdb_02.sas7bdat")

M2_C0_bornes0 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M2_C0_bornes0.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```

## Garder colonnes module

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
R2_A1 <- R2_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
    select(-c(id_date_creation:ps_interromp), -c(sc_type:sc_rdb_cat), -rdb_type) %>% 
    rename(
        "sc_rdb_an" = "rd_an",
        "sc_rdb_cause" = "rd_cause",
        "sc_rdb_classe" = "rd_classe",
        "sc_rdb_classe_autre" = "rd_classe_autre",
        "add_sc_rdb_classe_cat" = "rd_classe_cat"
    ) %>% 
        relocate(
            c("ps_redoubl", "rdb_ps_redoubl", "sc_rdb_classe", "sc_rdb_classe_autre",
            "add_sc_rdb_classe_cat", "sc_rdb_an", "sc_rdb_cause"), .after = rdb_date_creation
        )



```

## Identifier les absents

```{r}

vars_check <- R2_A1 %>%
  select(sc_rdb_classe, sc_rdb_classe_autre, sc_rdb_an, sc_rdb_cause) %>%
  colnames()

R2_A2 <- R2_A1 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    sc_rd_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

## Retirer les doublons

```{r}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons_1 <- R2_A2 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat == id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  # Ajouter variable pour identifier doublons et permettre d'ordonner les lignes
  
  mutate(
    is_og = if_else(
      id_anonymat == id_doublon, 0, 1
    ),
    .after = rdb_date_creation
  ) %>% 
  
  arrange(id_keep, is_og, sc_rdb_classe, sc_rdb_an) %>% 
    relocate(
            c("ps_redoubl", "rdb_ps_redoubl", "sc_rdb_classe_autre"), .after = last_col()
        ) %>% 
            relocate(id_anonymat, .after = id_keep)
  

# Garder que les lignes différentes ------------------------------------------------
  
doublons_2 <- doublons_1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les lignes pareilles
  distinct(
    pick(sc_rdb_classe:sc_rdb_cause),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  
  # Trouver ceux qui ont plus d'une ligne pour la même année
  group_by(id_keep, sc_rdb_an) %>% 
  mutate(
    n = n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(sc_rdb_an))

# Trier parmis ceux qui ont renseigné plus d'une fois une meme relation --------

doublons_3 <- doublons_2 %>%
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  # Garder la date de saisie la plus ancienne
  filter(rdb_date_creation == min(rdb_date_creation)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-is_og, -n)


# Corriger id_anonymat des doublons --------------------------------------------

doublons_corr <- doublons_3 %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  )

# Joindre les données propres
R2_B0 <- R2_A2 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_1$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, sc_rdb_classe, sc_rdb_an)

rm(list = c("doublons_1", "doublons_2", "doublons_3", 
            "doublons_corr"))

```


## Vérifier la variable borne 

```{r}

R2_B1 <- left_join(
  R2_B0,
  M2_C0_bornes0 %>% 
    select(id_keep, sc_complet, sc_rd_redoubl),
  by = "id_keep"
) %>% 
  relocate(c("sc_complet", "sc_rd_complet", "sc_rd_redoubl"), .after = rdb_date_creation) 

R2_B2 <- R2_B1 %>% 
  mutate(
    sc_rd_redoubl = 1
  ) %>% 
  select(-ps_redoubl, -rdb_ps_redoubl)

```


## Mettre à jour variable borne

```{r}

M2_C0_bornes1 <- M2_C0_bornes0 %>% 
  rows_update(
    R2_B2 %>% 
      select(id_keep, sc_rd_redoubl) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    R2_B2 %>% 
      select(id_keep, sc_rd_complet) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(sc_rd_complet, .after = sc_rd_redoubl) %>% 
  relocate(sc_complet, .after = sc_date_creation)

M2_C0_bornes2 <- M2_C0_bornes1 %>% 
  mutate(
    sc_rd_redoubl = case_when(
      !is.na(sc_rd_redoubl) ~ sc_rd_redoubl,
      is.na(sc_rd_redoubl) & sc_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(sc_rd_redoubl) & sc_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    sc_rd_complet = replace_when(
      sc_rd_complet,
      is.na(sc_rd_complet) ~ 0
    )
  )


```

```{r Export1}
"R2_A1", "R2_A2", "R2_A3"))

```

```{r}
R2_C0 <- R2_B2 %>%
```
